tabs.content:
.create table EnhancedTrafficEvents (
    // Core Event Identifiers
    PredictionId: string,
    Timestamp: datetime,
    EventId: string,    
    // Location Information
    LocationName: string,
    RoadName: string,
    Latitude: real,
    Longitude: real,    
    // AI Risk Predictions
    RiskLevel: string,                  // "High", "Medium", "Low"
    RiskScore: real,                    // 0.0 to 1.0
    RiskProbabilityHigh: real,          // Probability of high risk
    RiskProbabilityMedium: real,        // Probability of medium risk  
    RiskProbabilityLow: real,           // Probability of low risk
    Confidence: real,                   // Model confidence 0.0 to 1.0
    PrimaryFactors: string,             // Key risk factors identified
    AIExplanation: string,              // AI model explanation    
    // Traffic Metrics
    TrafficDensity: int,                // Traffic density percentage
    Weather: string,                    // Weather conditions
    Hour: int,                          // Hour of day (0-23)    
    // Alert System
    AlertTriggered: bool,               // Whether alert was triggered
    AlertSentTime: datetime             // When alert was sent (nullable)
)
